description: The boot check: a ROM banner was seen, and the printed ELF SHA-256 prefix starts the image's. The console text itself is never returned, only verdicts and counts.

console_bytes.description: How many raw bytes arrived from the port before the redaction. A count only: no console text is ever returned.

console_empty.description: The device sent nothing at all in the read window. It is a different outcome from a console that carried lines and did not match, and it is what an idle, already-booted Passport does: ask for `reset` to make it speak.

lines_omitted.description: How many console lines the *redaction* dropped. Not a measure of silence: `0` also means everything that arrived was kept, so read it with `console_empty`.

reset.description: Whether this call restarted the device before reading.
